articles.title: Bees may survive a swim by heading for the dark [COMIC]
articles.snippet: Researchers recently learned that bees can swim. New findings show that bees paddle toward shade and dark to reach shore.
articles.summary: Researchers recently discovered that bees are able to swim. New findings show that they paddle toward shade and dark areas to reach the shore.

articles.title: Is AI making us dumber? Depends how it’s used
articles.snippet: AI can weaken learning when it replaces effort. But tools that offer guidance rather than answers can help people hone their skills.
articles.summary: AI can make people learn less when it does all the work for them instead of making them try. However, tools that guide people instead of just giving answers can help them improve their skills.
